ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a transition-state structure containing a cyclic conjugated enone fragment, with a separate cyanide ion NC⁻ on the left side; in the main structure, there is a carbonyl C=O at the top, two C=C double bonds within the ring, one on the upper left side near the carbonyl and the other at the bottom; on the lower left side there is a gem-dimethyl-substituted carbon; a methyl group is connected to the lower alkene carbon; the tertiary carbon ortho to the carbonyl on the upper right side is connected to Br and a methyl group; its adjacent ring carbon is also connected to Br. There are also several curved arrows in the figure, but the problem requires ignoring these arrows. Reasoning: Only transcribe atoms and bonds, and do not encode curved arrows. According to the specified method, start numbering from the methyl-substituted alkene ring carbon and use ring-closure digit 1, proceed along the ring through the lower alkene, the left-side gem-dimethyl carbon, the upper-left alkene, the carbonyl, the tertiary carbon bearing Br and methyl, the adjacent carbon bearing Br, and then return to the starting point. The left-side gem-dimethyl is written as C(C)(C), the carbonyl is written as C(=O), the methyl and bromine on the tertiary carbon are written as C(C)(Br), and the bromine on the adjacent carbon is written as C(Br). The two intraring double bonds are represented with / and \ according to the relative directions in the figure, giving the main fragment C/C1=C/CC(C)(C)/C=C\C(=O)C(C)(Br)C(Br)CC1. Finally append the independent cyanide ion as a separate fragment, written as .[C-]#N.

raw_record.question_text: What is the SMILES expression of the transition-state structure shown in the image, ignoring the arrows?

method.method_draft: First transcribe only the atoms and bonds in the drawn transition-state structure, explicitly disregarding the curved arrows. Choose a ring starting atom at the methyl-substituted alkene carbon and walk around the ring through the enone and bromo-substituted centers, assigning a ring closure digit. Add branches for the left gem-dimethyl group, the lower methyl substituent, the carbonyl oxygen, the Br on the tertiary carbon, and the Br on the adjacent carbon. Encode the two ring double bonds with the slash/backslash stereochemical directions consistent with the drawing. Finally append the separate cyanide anion fragment after a dot, giving the SMILES `C/C1=C/CC(C)(C)/C=C\C(=O)C(C)(Br)C(Br)CC1.[C-]#N`.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中是一个含环状共轭烯酮片段的过渡态结构，左侧有单独的氰离子 NC⁻；主结构中上方有羰基 C=O，环内有两个 C=C 双键，一个在左上侧靠近羰基，另一个在下方；左下侧有一个偕二甲基取代的碳；下方烯烃碳上连有一个甲基；右上侧羰基邻位的叔碳连有 Br 和甲基；其相邻环碳也连有 Br。图中还有几条弯箭头，但题目要求忽略这些箭头。推理：只转录原子和键，不编码弯箭头。按指定方法，从带甲基取代的烯烃环碳开始编号并用环闭合数字 1，沿环经过下方烯烃、左侧偕二甲基碳、左上侧烯烃、羰基、带 Br 和甲基的叔碳、相邻带 Br 的碳，再回到起点。左侧偕二甲基写作 C(C)(C)，羰基写作 C(=O)，叔碳上的甲基和溴写作 C(C)(Br)，相邻碳上的溴写作 C(Br)。两个环内双键按图中相对方向用 / 和 \ 表示，得到主片段 C/C1=C/CC(C)(C)/C=C\C(=O)C(C)(Br)C(Br)CC1。最后将独立的氰离子作为单独片段追加，写作 .[C-]#N。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: This is the straightforward image-to-connection-table route: read the displayed skeletal structure atom by atom and encode it directly as a single disconnected SMILES with stereochemical alkene slash notation, rather than using reaction-mechanism interpretation.
planner_metadata.image_role: Use the image to identify the molecular graph while ignoring all curved arrows: a cyclic enone with a top ketone, two C=C bonds in the ring, a gem-dimethyl substituted ring carbon on the left, a methyl substituent on the lower alkene carbon, a tertiary carbon alpha to the carbonyl bearing methyl and Br, an adjacent ring carbon bearing Br, and a separate cyanide anion drawn as NC⁻.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the question text to know the requested output is the SMILES expression of the shown transition-state structure and that the arrows should be ignored, so only the static connectivity and stereochemistry of the drawn species are encoded.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Apply SMILES conventions for skeletal formulas: unlabeled vertices are carbons, line ends are hydrogens/alkyl substituents as implied, O above C is carbonyl C=O, Br labels are bromine substituents, the isolated NC⁻ fragment is encoded as [C-]#N, disconnected fragments are separated by '.', ring closure digits encode the macrocycle, branches encode methyl and bromo substituents, and / or \ encode the depicted alkene geometry.
